title: Rethinking knowledge in the Age of AI
description: **Rethinking Knowledge in the Age of AI** How is AI changing the way we search, organise knowledge, learn and stay curious? This meetup is a special collaboration between **Embrace**, **Ladies That UX** and **Quidgest**, who will kindly welcome us into their space for the evening. Together, we’ll explore different ways AI is reshaping our relationship with knowledge, from semantic search to the importance of curiosity in a fast-changing world. We’ll be joined by three speakers with different perspectives on how AI can help us search better, think better and keep learning. **Talk 1 - Beyond Words: Semantic Search with AI on Genio** **Speaker:** Francisco Azeredo, AI Engineer at Quidgest In this session, the speaker will demonstrate how Quidgest is transforming search on the Genio platform: moving beyond exact keyword matching and advancing toward true semantic understanding. Using word embedding models and nearest neighbor search, the system can now find what the user means, even if they don’t use the exact words. A seemingly small technical change, but one with a direct impact on the experience of hundreds of thousands of users, because it is built to mirror the way humans think. **Talk 2 - Why the Future Belongs to the Curious, Not the Experts** **Speaker:** Rita Sofio, Founder of Tech In Heels In this talk, Rita will explore how impostor syndrome is common among high performers and has become even more pronounced in the age of AI. She will explain how self-doubt is not a flaw, but often a natural result of growth, increasing responsibility and constant comparison. Through the A.C.T. Framework (Ask, Create, Test) Rita will show how curiosity, experimentation and action can help turn hesitation into confidence and make learning feel more accessible in a rapidly changing world. **Talk 3 - Harness, Skills, Evals, and Tools: Lessons** **from SE Ranking’s First Agents** **Speaker:** Mike Korenugin, VP of Product at SE Ranking Mike brings 10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, mostly working on data-heavy products, from Astorex, Jobjet and PandaDoc to SE Ranking. In this talk, he’ll share lessons from SE Ranking’s first agents, exploring harnesses, skills, evals and tools, while reflecting on what it means for product teams to turn dense data into workflows with great UX. **Agenda** 18:00 - Doors open & welcome 18:30 - First talk starts 18:50 - Second Talk 19:10 - Third Talk Whether you are already working with AI, exploring how to use it in your work, or simply curious about where things are going, this meetup is a space to learn, ask questions and connect with others in the community. Join us for an evening of practical insights, honest conversations and curious minds. See you there! **Supported by Quidgest** A special thank you to Quidgest for supporting this meetup and helping create a space where people can learn, share knowledge, and explore how AI is shaping the way we search, work, and think. **Stay connected** Follow **Embrace:AI** on LinkedIn to keep up with future events, community updates, and conversations around AI, technology, and learning together. [https://www.linkedin.com/company/embrace-ai-event/](https://www.linkedin.com/company/embrace-ai-event/)

description: Hello hello! 👋 So, after receiving so much love from you all this month (and since I promised some of you I'd share my approach to preparing for investing), I'm organizing this little workshop to give back to the community. I want to share what I've been doing to automate my financial life and put it on autopilot. We've been talking a lot about investing, but investing is actually the last step in the process. There are several foundational steps we should take first to make investing consistent and sustainable over time. **🚀 Investor Workshop: How I Built an Investing System That Runs on Autopilot** **1\. Automating the Foundation** 1.1 Auditing spending (looking back at the last 3 months) 1.2 Paying off expensive debt (if any) and building an emergency fund 1.3 Defining a realistic, sustainable budget 1.4 Setting up the automation infrastructure 1.5 Testing the system with small amounts so we can truly set it and forget it **2\. Preparing to Invest** 2.1 How I set my personal investment goals 2.2 What I've learned about optimizing taxes for my own situation 2.3 The criteria I use to choose my "boring" ETFs 2.4 How I figured out my true risk appetite 2.5 My brokerage criteria and my approach to cybersecurity (already shared during the last meetup) **3\. Execution & Maintenance** 3.1 The "test run" phase 3.2 Automating the actual investment plan 3.3 Routine check-ups 3.4 Financial entertainment: what I do to stay out of boredom once the system is up and running **4\. Documentation** ​4.1 The master map: Documenting all accounts and sharing the location with your most trusted person (or people). ​4.2 Legacy planning: The importance of making a will. **🚫 What this workshop is NOT** I won't be sharing my specific budget, portfolio, or telling you which exact ETFs to buy. Everyone has different backgrounds, goals, risk tolerances, and responsibilities. I'm simply sharing my own real-life experience so you can use it as a reference when building your own system. **🎯 What I hope to do** Make investing feel a little easier and fun **🐧 Some fun facts about me** • 10+ years in the rat race trying to make finance and investing simple, easy, and fun😆 • Failed to persuade my own dad—a 72-year-old retired physics professor—to embrace diversified ETFs instead of stock-picking. In the end, I realized that his happiness and his enjoyment of feeling like the smartest cookie in the family matter more than any numbers can bring🥰 • Failed to persuade my besties who work in AI to start investing because they think an AI bubble is coming and worry they'll lose money😅 **📋 Important Note:** This is a strictly non-commercial meetup. Nothing will be sold, and nothing shared should be taken as financial advice. Our goal is simple: connect, exchange perspectives, and enjoy thoughtful conversation with fellow investors — whatever your experience level.
